scope: All approved 1v1 tuning, including faster Nhan Kiem projectile and larger That Tinh impacts; standalone initial 1v1 lineups only.

reasons: Existing QA registry test contradicted its own manual-profile exclusion.
Eleven M4D fixtures still used protocol48, 180-second production wave assumptions or skipped new boss provocation. Runtime PvE was not changed to satisfy fixtures.
Retained asset SHA inputs required CRLF checkout, missing from attributes. Original hash values and all raster bytes retained.

Existing guest-scene ready marker timed out twice at 45s before combat. Foregrounding alone did not make the first retry pass; the diagnostic rerun passed with the same gate and timeout. Root cause of this intermittent wait is not established.

unitIntegration.limits: Retry counts come from the executed Vitest tool output; passing full suites were not rerun after fixture-only corrections.
